instructions.text: 1 Who do these words describe? Write T (Tom), A (Axel) or N (Niko).
2 Who is the woman describing? Listen and choose the correct picture in Exercise 1.
3 Label the pictures with words from the box.
4 Look at the pictures in Exercise 3. If the sentence is right, put a tick (✓). If it is wrong, put a cross (✗).
5 Listen to the sentences and decide if they are about the present or the future. Write P (present) or F (future).
6 When are they going to play tennis? Listen and choose the correct picture.
7 Match each suggestion with two possible replies.
8 Is each reply in Exercise 7 used to agree or disagree with the suggestion? Write A (agree) or D (disagree) next to each reply.
9 Where do they agree to have coffee? Listen and choose the correct picture.
